However, the 2nd respondent under the guise of laying an underground pipeline, is attempting to dispossess the petitioner from her plots without following the due process of law.

3. The learned Standing counsel appearing for the respondents submitted that the petitioner, along with others, had previously filed W.P.Nos.25693, 27156 and 28998 of 2018, wherein the action of the respondent Nos.2 to 5 therein was challenged in respect of the same survey number over which the petitioner is now claiming title of certain plots.

It is submitted that the petitioner's husband purchased the aforementioned properties, and the petitioner is currently in possession and enjoyment of the same.
However, the 2nd respondent under the guise of laying an underground pipeline, is attempting to dispossess the petitioner from her plots without following the due process of law.

2018, if they intended to lay drinking water pipelines through the subject land.
